value.name: Daniel confesses obsessive avoidance
value.description: Daniel admits he has been trying not to know whether the note existed by telling himself it was nothing and that it did not count.
evidence: "I told myself if I did not look, it did not exist. I told myself the note was nothing. A scrap. A draft. I told myself she had not actually done it, she had only thought about doing it. I told myself a lot of things."

value.name: Daniel reveals he has delayed opening the furniture
value.description: Daniel says he has spent two weeks in the house staring at a piece of furniture he suspects contains a will while trying to sell the house before anyone opens it.
evidence: "I have been sitting in this house for two weeks looking at a piece of furniture I knew might have a will inside it and trying to sell the house before anyone opened it."

value.name: Rosa quietly enters the doorway
value.description: Rosa appears at the doorway without announcing herself and addresses Daniel by name.
evidence: "Rosa, who had come up to the doorway at some point and had not announced herself, said, \"Daniel.\""

value.name: Rosa reassures Daniel of his goodness
value.description: Rosa tells Daniel he was a kind boy and reminds him that she has not forgotten that version of him.
evidence: "You were a kind boy," Rosa said. "You have forgotten that you were. I haven't."

value.name: Daniel breaks down crying
value.description: Daniel finally begins to cry, showing a raw, unpracticed grief after years of holding it in.
evidence: "He began, finally, to cry. It was not a graceful or showy thing. It was the cry of a man who had not done it in many years and had lost the technique."

value.name: Lucia comforts Daniel
value.description: Lucia crosses the room and sits beside Daniel, placing a hand on the back of his neck in a sisterly gesture.
evidence: "Lucia, after a moment, crossed the room and sat on the arm of his chair and put her hand on the back of his neck the way a sister does"

value.name: Asha retrieves the codicil
value.description: Asha leaves the sewing room carrying the codicil, indicating the document has been secured.
evidence: "Asha stepped quietly out of the sewing room with the codicil in her hand"

value.name: Asha brings the codicil to Priya
value.description: Asha walks to the kitchen and tells Priya that they have obtained the document.
evidence: "walked down the hall to the kitchen, where Priya was pretending very intently to study her notebook."

value.name: Priya confirms receipt of the codicil
value.description: Priya acknowledges Asha's announcement that they have the codicil.

value.name: Asha instructs Priya to secure evidence
value.description: Asha directs Priya to make copies, photograph the codicil with a ruler, and file the original away.
evidence: "Make a copy. Two copies. Photograph it on the table with a ruler. Put the original in the folder."

value.name: Priya agrees to preserve the document
value.description: Priya accepts Asha's instructions without hesitation, signaling cooperation in handling the codicil.
